title: Product Manager – Finance with FF Domain
jobDescription: About Newage Newage Software (www.newage-global.com) is a leading provider offreight forwarding software and digitized back-office services, designed tomeet the evolving needs of the freight forwarding and logistics industry. Our end-to-end SaaS-based ERPplatform and digital back-office solutions help logistics companies improveoperational efficiency, reduce cost leakages, and gain actionable businessinsights. These solutions leverage advanced technologies and automation tosupport businesses of all sizes—from small and medium enterprises to largeglobal organizations—across functions such as sales, finance, accounting,documentation, and customer operations. With 18+ years of industry expertise,Newage has established itself as a trusted technology partner for freightforwarders and logistics companies across global markets. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced ProductManager with strong expertise in Finance and Freight Forwarding domains todrive the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution of our logistics and supplychain technology products. The ideal candidate will bridge business needs,customer expectations, and technology capabilities to deliver innovativesolutions that enhance operational efficiency, financial visibility, andcustomer experience. The role requires deep understandingof freight forwarding operations, finance logistics processes, and SaaS productmanagement practices. ‍ Key Responsibilities ‍ Product Strategy & Roadmap Define and execute product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives. Identify market opportunities, industry trends, and customer pain points within freight forwarding and logistics operations. Prioritize product initiatives based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility. Drive product lifecycle management from concept to launch and continuous enhancement. Serve as the SME for Freight Forwarding - Finance process globally. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and define product solutions. Conduct workshops, product demos, and stakeholder discussions to align business needs with product strategy. ‍ Product Development & Delivery Create PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Partner with Engineering, QA, UX, and Business teams to deliver high-quality product releases using Agile methodologies. ‍ Market & Customer Insights Analyze market trends, competitor offerings, customer feedback, and product usage data to shape product decisions. Evaluate emerging technologies such as AI, automation, and analytics to drive innovation. ‍ Product Performance Define and track product KPIs, adoption, customer satisfaction, and business impact. Continuously improving products through data-driven decision-making and customer feedback. ‍ Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, or related field. MBA preferred. 12+ years of overall experience with at least 5+ years in Product Management. Strong domain expertise in Freight Forwarding, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Transportation Management. Must have strong understanding of logistics finance and accounting processes. Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms. Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum product development methodologies. Experience writing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. ‍ Preferred Domain Expertise Strong understanding of Freight Forwarding operations including Ocean Freight, Air Freight, NVOCC, Customs Clearance, Shipment Lifecycle Management, TMS, and WMS. Expertise on Finance processes including AP, AR, General Ledger Integration, Revenue Recognition, Cost Accruals, Profitability Management, and Financial Reporting. ‍ Desired Skills Product Strategy and Roadmap Management SaaS Product Development and Agile Methodologies Stakeholder and Customer Management Business Analysis and Process Mapping Data Analytics, Reporting, and API Integrations Strong Communication and Presentation Skills

title: Senior Associate
jobDescription: Job Title: Senior Associate Experience: 2 to 4 years Industry: Freight Forwarding Location: Chennai Shift : Day and Night Shift About us : Newage Software ( www.newage-global.com) is well-known for its freight forwarding software and digitized back-office services, which fulfil the ever-changing needs of freight forwarding and logistics industries. Key Accountabilities: • Shipping Documentation: Handle end-to-end shipping import/export documentation back-office process. • Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and standards. • Coordinate with shipping lines and other stakeholders. • Mailbox Management: Manage and oversee assigned mailboxes. • Provide timely responses to email queries. • Client Coordination: Maintain current knowledge of client scope requirements and processes. • Assist in resolving processing issues or customer escalations as they arise. • Provide regular updates to clients on shipment status and other relevant information. Required Qualifications: • Education: Any bachelor's degree, preferably in Logistics or Supply Chain Management. • Experience: 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in freight forwarding, with a focus on export and import shipping documentation and operations. Good knowledge of shipping and logistics concepts, good communication skills, proficiency in email writing. Ability to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure. ‍
